status: Service-loop batch complete: the last single-device-testable cells of guide 39.6's completion-and-progress table and the injectable half of guide 39.7's fault table now run on the live device. service_loop_independent_progress closes P07/P09/P10 at the software layer: a detached worker thread drives a full generation loop while the observer only reads status (P07), a bounded service publishes to two simultaneously-ready channels with the fast one completing mid-read of a deterministically slow reader in both orientations (P09, no head-of-line serialization), and shutdown with a resident GPU waiter drains inside the worker before it exits (P10, the join cannot strand live device work). nonfinite_reduction_gate closes F04: the host fold now carries a publication gate (the rank weights sum to 1 mod 2^64, so a corrupted partial — a quiet-NaN bit pattern included — breaks the exact identity deterministically) and the case proves both a flipped bit and a NaN pattern are rejected before publication with nothing written to the output slot; run_relay_round shares the same gate. host_wait_deadline_no_reuse closes F07: a consumer that finishes its whole verified read but withholds the acknowledgment fires the host's bounded wait (the spin_until timeout branch, dead code on a healthy device until now), the slot stays byte-identical, and the stop word recovers the waiter. Five-rank cross-device qualification remains pending the real five-GPU machine.

changes: case_service_loop_independent_progress (guide 34.1/34.2, 39.6 P07/P09/P10 software layer): phase 1, a detached worker thread drives channel B through 256 generations while the main thread performs no HIP call and no store (the observer only reads a progress flag; both sides bounded); phase 2, two simultaneously-ready channels where one reader is deterministically slow (delayed_reader) and the service publishes both tickets back to back, with the fast channel completing its verified read while the slow one is still mid-read, in both orientations; phase 3, shutdown with a resident bare waiter on channel A and the worker mid-loop on B: the worker publishes the stop words and drains both streams inside itself before exiting, and the observer only joins afterwards

case_nonfinite_reduction_gate (guide 35.5, 39.7 F04, 41.6): the host five-way fold now carries a publication gate — the rank weights sum to 1 mod 2^64, so the exact fold identity catches any corrupted partial (a quiet-NaN bit pattern is just another wrong word for these synthetic payloads); a flipped bit and a NaN pattern are both rejected before publication with nothing written to the output slot, and the clean fold passes; run_relay_round and the five_stream case and bench share the same gate

case_host_wait_deadline_no_reuse (guide 35.8 handoff deadline, 39.7 F07): a read_hold_kernel finishes its whole verified read but withholds the acknowledgment, so the host's spin_until timeout branch — dead code on a healthy device until now — fires at a 400 ms deadline; the slot stays byte-identical (no reuse while a reader is un-acknowledged) and the stop word recovers the waiter
